name: 8-Team 0.5 PPR Keeper League
//opponent_keepers: The other teams' keepers are the largest single source of error in any
draft board, because no public ranking knows about them. Fill in `known`
with real names as you learn them — that is always better than modelling.
Until then, `unknown_count` says how many of the other seven teams you
expect to keep somebody, and the simulator removes that many players drawn
from the top `pool_top_n` of the board, consuming each of those teams'
round-`round` picks. Run `python3 sim.py keepers` to see how much it moves.
